entities.summary: Nearly-enclosed warm inland sea. Mediterranean on the north shore grading to Persian-Gulf-style mangrove coast in the south. Functionally a Mediterranean + Persian Gulf hybrid.
Saharan-Arabian hyper-arid desert with scattered oases and wadi drainages.
Temperate continental grassland/semi-desert. Mongolian-Kazakh belt.
Seasonally flooding tropical river delta. Composite Inner Niger + lower Nile + Gangetic.
Southern African miombo-savanna highveld with Ethiopian-style grain farming on cooler uplands.
Volcanic wet-tropical high islands. Maluku/Sulawesi with Hawaiian-style peaks and fringing reefs.
Tropical Andean puna above cloud-forest. Central-Peruvian/Bolivian altiplano.

The Ngaru-Bon forge-ancestor. The industrial transition figure -- "works behind the wall the cattle cannot pass." Third in the Ngaru-Bon ancestral sequence, marking the shift from pastoral to metallurgical civilization.
The Oravan dyadic figure. Two aspects, not two gods. The ocean and the hearth are the same hand.
The Ndjadi nga-tier chthonic entity. River-bends, underground waters, the places where flow forgets its direction. The nga- prefix marks the localized, earthbound, subterranean cosmological tier.

The Ngaru-Bon first-ancestor. Cattle-origin figure -- "struck the first hollow" that cattle answered. The founding act of Ngaru-Bon civilization is an acoustic event: a hollow struck, an animal responding before a person could.
The Oravan Fire-House figure. The fire at the center of the house, the roof-beam junction, the domestic hearth. Not Maawara's hearth-aspect -- a separate, older entity.
The Kheshkai Sky figure. The ONE named high entity in Kheshkai theology. Not a god who blesses or curses -- a presence that notes. The Sky as impersonal WILL read through shamanistic interpretation.

The Qollari Ancestor-Stone figure. Mountain-facing, genealogical. The ancestor who became stone, whose back is every road. Reflects Qollari's membership in the Ancestor-Stone complex alongside their Sky-Mandate membership.
The Ndjadi ra-tier primordial entity. Not a person in the Oravan sense -- a grammaticalized cosmological position. The ra- prefix IS the theological claim.

Irrah ancestor figure. Explicitly NOT a deity -- classified as ancestor by Qalībin, keeping Irrah's structural rule: no named high deity. The Great Sealer, who stamps the tomb-brick. The highest-ranked named figure in Irrah, and still only an ancestor.
The Aethelian Basin has no calendar. This is not an absence. It is an architecture.

The Kheshkai do not have a calendar. This is not an absence. It is a doctrine.
